text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One useful method is SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. Breaking a project into milestones helps you track progress and stay motivated along the way. You should also define deliverables clearly, so everyone knows what the final results should look like. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters a lot. When all key people agree on the goals, it becomes much easier to avoid confusion and work together effectively. Good planning at the start saves time and prevents problems later.
